title: Content splice: each slot honestly signs different content -> RECEIPT_COMMON_MISMATCH
scenario: Both slots are honest signers, each over a different content, presented under one tuple.

test_universe.hooks: common_slots hook: common_gpg.content differs; both frames signed honestly

choices: S-P2's strict models carry no content-equality check or Spliced query; the strict evidence is the capstone C-C16 run.

needs: Live variant without a hook: take the kms pair from receipt R1 and the gpg pair from receipt R2 (two real receipts with different content); expected reason identical.

subcases.title: L3 form: one issue, slots sign different content
subcases.construction: TEST issue, adversarial; common_slots hook: the gpg frame's common.content = {TEST: 'other content'}; both frames signed honestly; A_sig stamped
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)

subcases.title: L0 form: splice two real receipts
subcases.construction: A-a; post-issue: the a_sig gpg pair replaced by (F_gpg, S_gpg) of a second honest receipt R2 with content {TEST: 'other content'}; receipt_anchor kept
subcases.T_derivation: T null: a_sig changed after stamping, so the receipt proof's digest no longer matches (row 11.2); U null with T (A10.1.1)
